source_of_items: financial-abm-lab:docs/audit/sieve_12_week_calendar_2026-08-16.md (v1.1) section 2.1, verbatim. The item list is NOT this file's to choose; this file only binds each item to a field.
pointer_syntax: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a RunManifest v2 document. '*' means 'every element of the array or map at this position'. A bracketed predicate ([source_kind=cli]) means 'the elements whose named member equals that value' — a readability shorthand, not RFC 6901.

profile.fail_rule: EVERY item in this map is a FAIL item for the contract profile (ruling of 2026-08-20, applied 2026-08-23). A run whose manifest does not resolve an item is non-conforming; there are no WARN items in this profile. Q1 is unaffected: the SCHEMA still admits the absence (git_commit and container_digest stay optional there), and it is this profile, not the schema, that makes the absence fatal. A weaker profile may downgrade items to WARN; it may not add items.
profile.status_is_not_reported_here: This file is STATIC: item -> field only. Per-run pass/fail is produced by the profile checker and lives beside the manifest, never inside it. A manifest that judged itself would be a second authority on conformance, and the one easiest to make agree with itself.

additional_profile_requirements.statement: A log supplied to the Cont harness or to a canary MUST declare l1_availability == 'inline' and carry `l1` on every event.
A conforming log MUST end with terminal book_level events enumerating resting depth per (side, price).

OPTIONAL conformance check, not a FAIL item: replay the contract's reference book reconstruction and assert reconstructed L1 == inline `l1`. A disagreement diagnoses either an incomplete log or a difference in matching semantics, and distinguishing those two is the check's purpose.
additional_profile_requirements.origin: gap G1, option (b), adopted as optional
